## Services and articles

- [Give people a reason to choose you.](https://michaelmck.site/marketing-branding/index.md): Websites, social media, video and brand development for Okanagan businesses. Clear positioning, memorable design and practical marketing. Custom project quotes.
- [Ideas you can put to work.](https://michaelmck.site/blog/index.md): Practical articles on AI implementation, web design and local marketing for Okanagan businesses.
- [What should an Okanagan business automate first?](https://michaelmck.site/blog/what-to-automate-first/index.md): Choose a first AI workflow by looking at recurring work, missing follow-ups and the cost of mistakes.
- [What makes a local business website worth enquiring through?](https://michaelmck.site/blog/website-that-turns-visits-into-enquiries/index.md): A practical website brief covering design, service information, proof and the path from a visit to a call.
